title: Extra Status Line Treatment Insulin Total
symptom: The user requests the ability to have the Extra Status Line display the current day's Treatment Insulin Total. Another user adds a request for two more options: bolus insulin administered in the same time period and a ratio of insulin total to carbs.
fix: The 1st March nightly contains extra status line option for Total Insulin, and users confirm it works.
evidence_quote: The 1st March nightly contains extra status line option for Total Insulin, please test and let me know if it works.
